definitions.explanation: A feeling or impression, especially an unpleasant or unsettling one. Often used in the compound {気味|きみ}が{悪|わる}い (creepy, unsettling).
Used as a suffix (～{気味|ぎみ}) after nouns or verb stems to indicate a slight tendency or early signs of a condition, often something undesirable.

examples.japanese: {気味|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{物音|ものおと}→物音：03633_monooto⟧がして、{気味|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: I heard sounds from a room that should have been empty, and it was unsettling.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧{気味|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: There's something creepy about that laugh.
I have a touch of a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧{気味|ぎみ}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I've been putting on a bit of weight lately, so I started exercising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧{気味|ぎみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Work has been running a bit behind schedule, so I've been doing overtime.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
As a standalone noun, {気味|きみ} is most commonly used in the phrase {気味|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (creepy, unsettling). As a suffix, it attaches to nouns or verb stems with the reading ぎみ (voiced): ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧{気味|ぎみ}, ⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧{気味|ぎみ}, ⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧{気味|ぎみ}.

Note the reading difference: {気味|きみ} as a standalone word vs. ～{気味|ぎみ} as a suffix.

Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{君|きみ}→君：01384_kimi⟧ (you), which uses different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気味|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: creepy, unsettling
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧{気味|ぎみ}: touch of a cold
- ⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧{気味|ぎみ}: slightly overweight
- ⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧{気味|ぎみ}: running a bit behind
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧{気味|ぎみ}: somewhat tired
